comment: Hand-curated gaps in what the two generated sources can say about --aura-* properties.
`properties` classifies the ones the Aura reference pages in vaadin/docs do not cover; everything
documented is classified from the Read-only / light-dark() badges instead (see lib/parse-docs.mjs).
`undeclared` lists documented properties that @vaadin/aura deliberately never declares, so that a
property vanishing from the CSS is reported instead of being read as an opt-in hook.
generate.mjs fails on any entry here that is no longer needed, so neither list can accumulate.

--aura-accent-color-light-initial.reason: Snapshot of the application-level accent color. Aura reads it to restore the accent inside scoped accent contexts (.aura-accent-* class names), so overriding it detaches those contexts from the theme.

--aura-accent-color-dark-initial.reason: Snapshot of the application-level accent color. Aura reads it to restore the accent inside scoped accent contexts (.aura-accent-* class names), so overriding it detaches those contexts from the theme.

--aura-overlay-outline-shadow.reason: Assembles the two overlay outline colors into a box-shadow. Set --aura-overlay-outline-color and --aura-overlay-inner-outline-color instead.

--aura-item-overlay-padding-inline.reason: Undocumented internal property behind the padding and corner radius of overlay items. Not part of Aura's public API.

--aura-item-overlay-padding-block.reason: Undocumented internal property behind the padding and corner radius of overlay items. Not part of Aura's public API.

--aura-font-smoothing.reason: An opt-in hook with no default: Aura only reads it, as var(--aura-font-smoothing, antialiased), so there is nothing for the CSS to declare.
